data.title: 菲伦 · 雪夜旅店的魔法木桶浴
data.description: 风雪夜，旅店的木桶浴池蒸汽氤氲。菲伦把紫色长发盘起来，闭着眼靠在桶沿，脸颊被热水蒸得粉红。桶边的小凳上搁着翻开的魔法书，她一边泡澡一边默念着咒语，火烛在壁龛里轻轻摇晃——「……水温刚刚好。再泡一会儿，就一会儿。」
data.action: 闭眼靠在木桶沿，桶边搁着魔法书
data.lighting: warm candlelight from alcove, rising steam, soft snow-glow from window
data.promptProse: She reclines against the wooden tub with her eyes closed, quietly reciting a spell. The open spellbook rests on a dry stool beside her. Alcove candlelight warms the steam against the cool snowlight at the window.
data.identityProseOverride: Fern from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, with purple hair pinned up, straight bangs, long sidelocks and violet eyes.
data.animaCaption: The spellbook stays open on a dry stool beside the tub.
